title: Jaise Khwaja ne Kaha
body:
alal elaan kaho sar e maidan kaho
hai hussain ibne ali deen ki jaan kaho
<<DIVIDER>>
us namazi pe na ho kaise allah ko naaz
toote teeron pe ada ki hai maqtal mein namaz
haq hai uska jo ise haq ki pehchan kaho
alal elaan kaho sar e maidan kaho
jaise khwaja ne kaha deen panah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
pehno ehraam agar choomo kaabe ka ghilaf
jaake kaabe mein karo jab bhi kaabe ka tawaf
shukriya jaane ali hajj ke dauran kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya kehne lage dekh ke is ki taraf
isne baksha hai hame sar faraazi ka sharaf
har shariyat ka yehi hai nigehban kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocho kaabe se kabhi uske sajde ki chamak
roshni phail gayi saatwein arsh talak
arsh waalon pe bhi hai us ka ehsaan kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye chaaron taraf dhoom is naam ki hai
aaj bhi karbobala dhaal islam ki hai
baat insaaf ki hai sab musalman kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ne muqtal mein rakhi lafze islam ki laaj
maut se isne kiya chadh ke naize pe khiraaj
roohe islam kaho jaane quran kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ki raahon mein fida apna ghar baar kiya
thak ke soya tha bashar usne bedaar kiya
mazhare zaate khuda hai ye insan kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir akhtar bakhuda ye na hota jo kahin
rakhta kis simt bashar apni sajde mein jabeen
jaane zehra pe hai ye jaan qurban kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
